business_summary: Jiangsu Olive Sensors High-Tech Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production, and sales of various automotive sensors and engineering plastic parts in China and internationally. The company's products and services include sensors and accessories, fuel system accessories, automotive interior parts, and new energy components. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Hi-Tech Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangsu Olive Sensors High-Tech Co., Ltd. in October 2010. Jiangsu Olive Sensors High-Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Yangzhou, China.
